headline: Executive order creates a federal task force focused on eliminating fraud.
what_it_does: This executive order sets up a new federal task force whose stated purpose is to eliminate fraud. No summary of the order was provided, so details such as which agencies take part, what kinds of fraud it targets, and what powers it has are not known from the available information.

who_it_affects.how: Some federal agencies will likely take part in or work with the new task force, though the specific agencies are not stated in the available information.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 16, 2026; the specific effective date is not stated in the available information.
